header.comment: This configuration file was automatically created by GParserBuilder

n_variables.comment: The number of variables to act on

delays.comment: A list of delays through which main() should cycle. Format: seconds:milliseconds

sleep_randomly.comment: Indicates whether the individual should sleep for a random amount of time
rather than a fixed amount of time

lower_rand_sleep_boundary.comment: The lower boundary for random sleep times in the

upper_rand_sleep_boundary.comment: The upper boundary for random sleep times in the

result_file.comment: The name of a file to which results should be stored

short_result_file.comment: The name of a file to which short results should be stored

n_measurements.comment: The number of measurements for each delay

inter_measurement_delay.comment: The amount of seconds to wait between two measurements

may_throw.comment: Indicates whether the fitness function may throw after the sleep time

throw_likelihood.comment: Indicates the likelihood that the fitness function throws

eval_policy.comment: Specifies which strategy should be used to calculate the evaluation:
0 (a.k.a. USESIMPLEEVALUATION): Always call the evaluation function, even for invalid solutions
1 (a.k.a. USEWORSTCASEFORINVALID) : Assign the worst possible value to our fitness and evaluate only valid solutions
2 (a.k.a. USESIGMOID): Assign a multiple of validity_level_ and sigmoid barrier to invalid solutions, apply a sigmoid function to valid evaluations

steepness.comment: When using a sigmoid function to transform the individual's fitness,
this parameter influences the steepness of the function at the center of the sigmoid.
The parameter must have a value > 0.

barrier.comment: When using a sigmoid function to transform the individual's fitness,
this parameter sets the upper/lower boundary of the sigmoid.
The parameter must have a value > 0.

max_unsuccessful_adaptions.comment: The maximum number of unsuccessful adaptions in a row for one call to adapt()

max_retries_until_valid.comment: The maximum allowed number of retries during the
adaption of individuals until a valid solution was found
A parameter set is considered to be "valid" if

maxmode.comment: Specifies whether the individual should be maximized (1) or minimized (0)
Note that minimization is the by far most common option.

use_random_crash.comment: Indicates whether random crashes should occur for debugging purposes

random_crash_prob.comment: The probability of a random crash to occur
